scope: Production-host shadow test of frozen fixtures. Stopwatch measures provider adapters and fixture analysis, not end-to-end requests; no production traffic switch.
findings: This paired sample was 22911ms without reuse and 13357ms with reuse; audio was 13389ms versus 3830ms, while vision was 9517ms versus 9349ms.
The previous 42978ms sample was not instrumented, so its cause remains unknown.
One paired sample is insufficient for a P90 or reliable speedup claim; upstream caching and provider variance remain unmeasured.
No human evaluation of final answers or real authorization replay was performed.
